column7: Seconds before expiry an OAuth token is refreshed: the set value, else max(300 s, 10% of the token lifetime), else 300 s (MIK-8044). Decides refresh timing, never an authorization; pinned by an_unset_buffer_derives_from_the_token_lifetime.

Picks the JWKS URI an issuer's tokens are verified against when its discovery URL is derived: the discovered one, or {issuer}/.well-known/jwks.json only when discovery cannot be reached; a refused document is an error, never a fallback (MIK-8044)
Fetches and validates the discovery document and classifies its failure: unreachable (connection, non-2xx, undecodable) may fall back; refused (issuer mismatch, insecure jwks_uri) may not (MIK-8044)
Records the fallback JWKS URI for at most min(cache TTL, 300 s), atomically, so discovery is retried and a recovered issuer's keys replace the fallback's (MIK-8044)

Returns the key set a token is verified against: a cached set is reused only while fresh and only for the URI it was fetched from, so a fallback's keys stop verifying once discovery names another URI (MIK-8044)
